Statistical methods
Subject-level tests.
The claim is that the gain holds across subjects, so every test is at the subject
level. The macro AUROC of a subject’s two sessions is averaged into one value, so each subject
contributes one gain. Within-session and cross-session have 6 subjects and cross-subject has 5, since
subject 2 is the anchor.
Permutation test.
We run an exact paired permutation test on the subject means. The difference
